labels.anchor_text: DNA was extracted by a standard phenol/chloroform method.
labels.rationale: The word standard carries no parameters and no citation, so this is a deferral with no target. But phenol/chloroform extraction of tissue and blood is conventional, and endpoint PCR tolerates a wide range of yield and purity. A competent lab proceeds without asking.

Table 1 lists four primer pairs: methylated and unmethylated for each of two genes. The text gives two annealing temperatures and maps them to the two genes, not to the four pairs. Methylated and unmethylated primer pairs differ in GC content and usually need different temperatures. The reader cannot tell which of the four reactions runs at which temperature. GAP_VAGUE is the closest legal code, but the real defect is an ambiguous referent. See AMB-105.
